description: Where each shipped icon's ink begins. 'profiles' is the ink's bounding box as fractions of its square, [left, right, top, bottom]; 'edges' is where the ink begins along 33 lines across each side, one character per line in 64ths of the square ('A' = 0, '/' = 63, '.' = no ink), sides joined by '|' in the same order (see plugin/src/infragram/catalog/ink.py). Keyed by the sha1 of the artwork's shape (first 12 hex digits); an icon that fills its square has no entry. Both renderers seat a wire's end on the ink and the checker holds them to it. 'ports' is where a side's connection point sits for the drawings the rule places badly, as a fraction along the side, set by hand in scripts/tools/ink-profiles.py (a person's body, not the neck).
